note: P10's oracle: per-phase charge from a current trace and a marker code per sample. Currents are amperes, dt is seconds, charges are coulombs. Every case is chosen so the charge is exact in binary floating point: currents are sums of powers of two and dt is 2^-10 seconds, so no case depends on a tolerance to pass. The chapter's codes are 0 sleep, 1 wake, 2 sense, 3 compute, 4 send and 7 fault.

cases.why: one phase, one sample, the smallest ledger there is
four phases of two samples each, the shape of a duty cycle
the same phase twice, separated, accumulates into one code
a single-sample run rejected at a floor of two, and the residual is NOT zero because its charge is in the total and not in the split
the same trace at a floor of one keeps everything and the residual returns to zero, which is the pair that shows the floor is what moves it
the fault code is carried rather than refused, because a trace containing one is a finding
an unused code, five, is carried for the same reason
a zero trace, where the residual cannot be formed and is reported as one rather than as a division
no samples at all is refused
a sample interval of zero is refused rather than producing a ledger of zeros
a negative sample interval is refused
a floor of zero samples is refused, since every run is at least one
a marker code above seven cannot come from three pins and is refused
